cards.title: Moon Muffin Pencil Tip Arrival
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper-only pencil cup opening card for starting a fictional moon-market story from a pretend pencil cup picture: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place this card beside blank paper and a drawn pencil cup, then invite one invented visitor into Moon Muffin Market: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start the story when a made-up moon muffin character steps out from behind the pencil cup: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: Write the moment the moon-market stall first notices the visitor: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character arrival: The character who arrives carrying a tiny pencil-cup clue is ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place clue: The visitor arrives near the pretend moon muffin stall called ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object clue: One pencil-cup object that matters in the opening is ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: Why did the visitor come to the moon muffin counter today? ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: The visitor gently asks the stall helper to ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: Add one moon-market detail that makes the arrival easier to picture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the arriving character first, then write one arrival word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use another blank page to begin a pretend market tale with one new visitor: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Bottle-Cap Invitation

cards.adultSetup: Adult: Set out blank paper and point to one pretend pencil-cup object that can become puddle mail: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Begin when the object from the pencil cup turns into a friendly invitation on Puddle Planet: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: Write the first thing the tiny puddle post office does with the invitation: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character prompt: The puddle mail helper who finds the object is ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place prompt: The invitation appears beside the pretend puddle counter called ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object invitation: The pencil-cup object that invites the story to begin is ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: What does the invitation ask the puddle helper to try first? ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: The helper places the invitation into a bottle-cap pouch and ____________________.

cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle the invitation object and copy one puddle-mail word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Start another pretend mail story with one paper object that invites the plot: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Shelf Doorway Tap
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable pencil cup opening card for starting a fictional library-train tale by entering through one invented place doorway: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside a drawn pencil cup and ask which pretend doorway opens near the Buttonwood Library Train: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the opening as if the pencil cup points toward a tiny doorway into the library train: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: Begin at the exact moment the shelf doorway taps open: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character prompt: The traveler waiting by the doorway is ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place doorway: The doorway leads into the library-train stop called ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object prompt: The pencil-cup clue beside the doorway is ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: What shelf question is waiting on the other side of the doorway? ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: The traveler steps through, listens for the library wheels, and ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: Add one buttonwood, ticket, bell, or bookmark detail to sharpen the doorway scene: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the doorway shape and write one word from inside it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Open another pretend story by drawing a doorway first, then writing one first line: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Crumb-Map Question
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper-only pencil cup opening card for beginning a fictional bakery-map story with one gentle question hook: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Put this card by blank paper and invite a made-up question about a folded button map: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start the story with a question that makes the button bakery map feel curious but safe: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: Write a sentence that begins with the bakery-map question or answers part of it: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character prompt: The map-mender or crumb clerk asking the question is ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place prompt: The question appears at the pretend bakery-map corner called ____________________.

cards.questionPrompt: Question hook: What does the folded button map seem to be asking? ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: After the question, the map-mender gently turns the page and ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: Move the strongest question word closer to the first sentence: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the question mark and one clue word before adding the blank: ____________________.

cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: The watcher looks through the tiny pane and ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: Replace one plain sound with a teacup-town sound that feels more specific: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Tap the paper once silently, then write one sound word: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Crooked Notice Dot
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper-only pencil cup opening card for beginning a fictional notice-board story with one small invented problem: ____________________.

cards.kidDirection: Open the pocket-park story by showing a small notice-board problem that can be solved gently: ____________________.
cards.firstLinePrompt: First line: Write the first moment someone notices the crooked dot on the board: ____________________.
cards.characterPrompt: Character prompt: The pocket-park notice keeper who spots the tiny problem is ____________________.
cards.placePrompt: Place prompt: The tiny problem appears at the pretend park board called ____________________.
cards.objectPrompt: Object prompt: The pencil-cup object that helps point to the problem is ____________________.
cards.questionPrompt: Opening question: Why does the tiny notice problem matter in this invented park? ____________________.
cards.nextMovePrompt: First next move: The notice keeper smooths the paper corner and ____________________.
cards.reviseOpeningPrompt: Revise opening: Make the problem smaller, clearer, and easier to fix in the first paragraph: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Mark the tiny problem with a paper dot, then write one clue word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Start another pretend notice-board tale with one tiny problem and one gentle first move: ____________________.
